title: Telemetry data-flow audit: enumerate every field that leaves the machine
question: What exact fields does the telemetry/privacy contract permit to leave the machine, what does the code actually send, and which sent field is not in the contract?
answer: Phase 4 contract artifact ARC-0096 is absent. The executable allowlist is IMP-0397 RECORDED_FIELDS ['join_key', 'month', 'event_type', 'session_id']. emit_records also constructs ['join_key_name', 'join_key_scope', 'offered', 'outcomes', 'used'], which are not in that allowlist. tools/router has no HTTP client, so those fields do not leave the machine on this worktree unless a caller posts them. A local intercepting sink proxy observing json.dumps(emit_records(...)) sees the same production keys; a scratch payload planting prompt is caught on the wire.
